Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: recruit through a trader
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Ask a visiting trader to spread word of the colony on their travels. Applicants come from the trader's faction and walk in.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: recruit with an envoy
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Send a colonist out as an envoy. They are away for the whole drive and come back with any applicants. A better social skill makes the trip shorter and more likely to succeed.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map with the envoy

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: radio broadcast
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Broadcast a call for settlers from a powered comms console. Applicants walk in. Radio cannot reach the planet from space.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: orbital comms
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Relay a call for settlers through orbit from a powered comms console. Applicants drop in by transport pod near the colony, and this also works from space.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: drop in by transport pod near the colony
